LESSON: DRAWING MAKING TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.1: Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. develop simple pictures using doodling techniques for eye hand co-ordination,
2. appreciate own and others drawn work . comment on own and others work

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. develop simple pictures using doodling techniques for eye hand co-ordination,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop simple pictures using doodling techniques for eye hand co-ordination,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate own and others drawn work . comment on own and others work
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own and others drawn work . comment on own and others work. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES.
2. Explain Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Provide learner with drawing 1. What would you like MAKING 1.1.1 Scribbling and learner should be able to: materials to draw? TECHNIQUES doodling a) develop simple pictures
4. Show that you can: develop simple pictures using doodling techniques for eye hand co-ordination,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Drawing MAKING TECHNIQUES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
